issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water Fund 45,680.10, Sewer Fund 15,205.15
issues.issue: The only receipts of the Water and Sewer funds are almost certainly utility charges (user rule: utility fund sales/charges -> Utility Charges). The printed label says 'Other' and no breakdown is printed, so 'other' with review is defensible, but 'Utility Charges' is the likely fit.
